_POSIX_MONOTONIC_CLOCK

Note

In Issue 7 (200809L), _POSIX_MONOTONIC_CLOCK was an optional option. Issue 8 (202405L) promoted it to a mandatory POSIX system-interface option.

Enable this option with CONFIG_POSIX_MONOTONIC_CLOCK, or enable the XSI_ADVANCED_REALTIME option group with CONFIG_XSI_ADVANCED_REALTIME.
